description: July 21, 2024 CINCINNATI, OH — Today, Rep. Greg Landsman released the following statement regarding President Joe Biden’s decision to suspend his campaign: The President is putting the country and our democracy first, as he has done for decades.  His decision is truly a patriotic one.
